```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(fpp3)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4
)
source("lab_submission.R")

lab_meta <- list(id = "lab12", title = "Seasonal ETS")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "In ETS notation, additive Holt–Winters is closest to:",
  q2 = "If residual ACF still has lag-4 spikes after Holt (no season), you should:",
  q3 = "Which Beer model would you take to forecasting? Cite residual ACF + AICc."
)
```

## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Tournament
```{r hw-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=14}
library(fpp3)
fit <- aus_production |>
  model(
    holt = ETS(Beer ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("N")),
    hw = ETS(Beer ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("A")),
    auto = ETS(Beer)
  )
fit |> select(hw) |> components() |> autoplot()
glance(fit) |> arrange(AICc)
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("(A, A, A)", correct = TRUE),
  answer("(A, N, N)"),
  answer("(M, N, N)"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Try a seasonal ETS / seasonal method", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Stop — residuals never matter"),
  answer("Always difference twice"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Pick … because AICc … residuals …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```
